title: Fix three bugs in a Go temperature converter
description: Three conversion functions have wrong formulas: CtoF ignores the scaling factor, FtoC applies operations in wrong order, CtoK uses wrong constant.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in temp.go:
1. `CtoF`: change `c + 32` to `c*9/5 + 32`
2. `FtoC`: change `f*5/9 - 32` to `(f-32)*5/9`
3. `CtoK`: change `274.15` to `273.15`
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
